text: Added DesignExportError plus Either-returning variants for designTable, designMap, correlationMap, eventPlotData, baselinePlotData, and contrastPlotData. Existing throwing helpers now delegate through unsafe wrappers. Covered structured errors for column mismatch, missing event/baseline terms, empty contrasts, empty selector results, and sampling/design row mismatch. Verification: sbt -no-colors designJVM/test designJS/test passed, 126 tests on each platform.
